rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for something that does not last or is not permanent.

example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 gam2 cing4 m4 coeng4 gau2

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something lasts only a short time, rather than merely saying that it is not permanent.

example.english: This kind of happiness is impermanent.
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 faai3 lok6 hou2 dyun2 zaam6
